product.description: Paris, 1614. Pardaillan și Jehan o caută pe fiica acestuia din urmă, răpită după câteva luni de la naștere. Cei doi Pardaillan sunt ajutați în căutările lor de către un tânăr văr, viteazul conte Odet de Valvert, pe care cavalerul îl iubește ca pe un fiu. Atunci când Jehan este chemat să fie alături de soția lui bolnavă, Odet devine cel mai bun ajutor al lui Pardaillan. Însă contele e foarte îndrăgostit de o fată săracă, în realitate, copilul natural al lui Concini și al lui Marie de Medici. Le va hărăzi oare destinul împlinirea iubirii celor doi tineri prinși în urzelile complicate ale puterii?

Step back into the dramatic world of early 17th-century France with **The Pardaillan Knights: The End of Pardaillan (Volume 10)**. This captivating installment continues the epic saga of noble families, political intrigue, and enduring romance within the heart of Renaissance Paris. If you are looking for rich historical fiction that blends thrilling adventure with complex human drama, this volume is a must-read addition to your collection.

## Unraveling Parisian Secrets in 1614

The year is 1614. The story finds Pardaillan and Jehan embarking on a desperate quest: locating the daughter of one of their own who was abducted shortly after her birth. Their search is not undertaken alone. They receive crucial assistance from Odet de Valvert, a young cousin and skilled knight whom the main protagonist regards with deep affection.

As the political landscape shifts, personal duty calls Jehan away to be with his ailing wife. In this vacuum of time, Odet becomes Pardaillanâs most reliable companion and trusted ally. However, fate has other plans. The count finds himself consumed by love for a poor young womanâa girl who is secretly the natural child of powerful figures like Concini and Marie de Medici.

Will these two young lovers manage to defy destiny? Caught in the intricate and dangerous webs woven by power, status, and royal ambition, they face challenges that threaten the very fabric of their lives and love. *The End of Pardaillan* delivers a sweeping conclusion filled with suspense and emotional depth.

*   **Immersive Setting:** Experience life in Paris during the reign of powerful figures, blending high society drama with genuine historical detail.
